messages:
jordan: Quick preflight for Ravena POC — they want to serve `ravena-13b-v2` (Llama-derivative). Main asks: hosted vs Dedicated recommendation, quantized variant compatibility (q4/int8), KV cache behavior for chat, KMS/BYOK, and SOC2/DPA. They expect ~100 rps burst, ~300 token avg. Sam attached their sec questionnaire: https://ravena.ai/sec/qna

tess (Solutions Eng): On hosted we can usually run Llama-derivatives if tokenizer/arch align. Need HF link or repo and tokenizer config to confirm RMSNorm/rotary kernels. Can we get artifacts from the customer?

sam (Ravena): Link: https://internal.ravena.ai/models/ravena-13b-v2 (private S3). It uses rotary pos emb + RMSNorm. We'll provide weights in private S3 and can share a small prompt set.

mike (Infra): RMSNorm + rotary ok at runtime. Quantized variants probably fine but need a compatibility sweep — gating points: optimized attention kernels and seq len (they might hit 1024). For 100 rps and predictable p99, Dedicated pool recommended.

tess: KV cache note — streaming chat requires sticky sessions/affinity to reuse KV. Hosted supports prefix KV caching; Dedicated gives more deterministic reuse. Recommend Dedicated if they need sub-200ms p95.

lena (Security): We need to know deployment model: will weights live in their S3 and we pull to Hosted, or do they want Private (VPC/on‑prem)? Private changes compliance path. Also need KMS ARN for BYOK and answers to the DPA/SOC2 questions.

sam (Ravena): We prefer Private VPC if possible. We control the S3 and use AWS KMS (we can share the key ARN). We have a filled security questionnaire but need Redwood to confirm data flow.

jordan: Action items: 1) Tess to validate tokenizer + run quick compatibility sweep; 2) Mike to run quantized variant perf/latency sweep and cost estimate; 3) Lena to start sec questionnaire + DPA flow; 4) I'll draft pricing bands (hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved) and share. ETA EOD Tue.

tess: I need the model artifacts URL + sample tokenizer config + 50 prompt seed set to run quality regressions. Also indicate any custom ops.

mike: I'll schedule a perf job tomorrow. Early back-of-envelope: q4_0 cuts memory ~40%, Dedicated reserved costs ~60% less per-token than bursty hosted. Precise token cost after sweep — but expect dedicated to be significantly cheaper at 100rps sustained.

lena: :thumbsup: I'll ping legal for DPA and check SOC2 implications for Private vs Hosted. If they want Hosted with S3 pull, we need to review S3 access IAM, VPC endpoints, and audit logging.

sam: One more: can Redwood do runtime variant switching? E.g., q4 for normal ops and fallback to fp16 for quality regressions.

tess: Yes — we support policy-based variant routing and can configure canary/A/B rollouts and automatic fallback by quality checks. We'll include a rollout plan in the POC.

jordan: Good. I'll send a meeting invite Wed 09:30 PT with Sam + SE + Infra + Security. Mike, add eng-oncall for perf review.

mike: Added eng-oncall. I'll attach preliminary perf numbers once sweep completes.

sam: Thanks all — timeline works. Looking forward to the meeting.
